summary: Süleyman Demirel International Airport (ISE/LTFC) serves Isparta, a city in southwestern Turkey's Lakes Region. Named after the former Turkish President Süleyman Demirel, who was born in nearby Atabey, the airport provides vital connectivity for the province known for rose cultivation, carpet weaving, and apple production. It also serves as a convenient gateway to the popular resort town of Burdur and the scenic Lakes District.
faqs:
Q: How far is the airport from Isparta city center?
A: The airport is approximately 25 km northeast of Isparta's city center, with a typical drive time of around 30-40 minutes depending on traffic.

Q: Which airlines operate flights from Isparta Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by Turkish Airlines with scheduled domestic flights, mainly connecting Isparta to Istanbul. Seasonal and charter flights may operate during tourism periods.

Q: Does the airport have international flights?
A: While named 'International,' the airport currently operates mainly domestic flights, with limited or seasonal international services depending on demand.

Q: Are there car rental services at the airport?
A: Yes, several car rental agencies operate at or near the airport, providing convenient options for exploring the Lakes Region independently.
transport_tips: HAVAŞ airport shuttle buses connect the terminal to Isparta city center and nearby towns on scheduled timings aligned with flight arrivals. Taxis are readily available outside the terminal and offer a straightforward option, though agreeing on a fare in advance is recommended. Renting a car is highly advisable if you plan to explore the Lakes Region, including destinations like Burdur Lake, Egirdir Lake, and the ancient site of Sagalassos.
local_tip: If you have a layover or extra time, ask about visiting the Isparta Rose Gardens (Gül Bahçesi) during the May-June harvest season, when the surrounding fields transform into fragrant pink landscapes and you can witness rose oil distillation—a regional specialty unique to this part of Turkey.
